title: The actual displayed size of SubViewportContainer will be different in standalone window and in-editor window.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta1.mono.official [d33da79d3]

I'm using windows version.

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.4 beta 1 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT - Intel(R) Xeon(R) w7-3455   2.40 GHz

### Issue description

The actual displayed size of SubViewport will be different in stand-alone window and in-game window.
I made a script that resizes SubViewport to the entire screen.
In the exported exe, it is displayed as expected, but in-game window, is not.

### Steps to reproduce

Setup a SubViewport with container (see: stretch is on)...

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5ea3526-22d1-496b-8f76-bb18957b9a88)

Then, wrote a script that respects the window size change and attached it to the `SubViewport` (C# is also OK. Same problem will happen):

```gdscript
extends SubViewport

func  _ready():
	get_window().size_changed.connect(on_size_changed)
	resize()

func on_size_changed():
	var size = get_window().size;
	print("size changed:", size)
	resize()

func resize():
	var size: Vector2i = get_window().size;
	var container: SubViewportContainer = get_parent();
	container.size = size;
	var sprite: Sprite2D = get_child(0);
	sprite.transform = Transform2D.IDENTITY \
		.scaled_local(Vector2(size.x, size.y)) \
		.translated(Vector2(size.x / 2.0, size.y / 2.0))
```

Then, run from Rider or exported exe:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77fddab5-82df-4563-a193-2f0704eacf20)

You can see only the white sprite!

But from in-editor game window...

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6c46a1c-9f4a-49cd-8f4b-1d673f7faea2)

There is a gray background.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[viewport-test_2025-01-27_18-54-23.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18556485/viewport-test_2025-01-27_18-54-23.zip)

C# script is also contained. Same issue will happen also in C#.
